FIXES_APPLIED.description: Added restricted protocol check before page.goto() — blocks chrome://, about:, chrome-extension://, devtools:, view-source:
Added requireAuth to all methods — POST endpoint could trigger DB writes without auth
Removed debug field containing raw error.message from HTTP response
Removed error field containing raw error.message from HTTP response

DESIGN_LIMITATIONS: RecoveryEngine has own governance (ActionRegistry) bypassing HumanActionEngine — by design for operational recovery
SelfRepairEngine has own governance with R0/R1 auto-authorization — by design for low-risk repairs
Stripe webhooks use signature verification, not HumanActionEngine — correct auth model for external webhooks
DelegatedAuthority lacks goalId scoping — scoped by identity/session/capability/resource
Service tokens lack replay protection — 5-minute window with no seen-request tracking
Event deduplication is opt-in via idempotencyKey — mechanism exists but not enforced by default
Control plane doesn't enforce terminal state checks on event recording — governance pipeline enforces
FALSE_POSITIVES: api/rezonate/route.js claimed unauthenticated — has requireAuth at line 87
api/song-composer/songs.js claimed unauthenticated — has requireAuth at lines 24 and 49
Encoded traversal claimed not blocked — Next.js framework URL-decodes before code sees path
Scripts using child_process claimed as production paths — not production runtime
Stripe webhook event payload claimed as secret leak — Stripe events contain PII, not API keys
